subject: EXTERNAL clause
notes: kb/Work PB1026. cite.py --check 13.18.22.4 "the data contained in all record description entries subordinate to that file description entry is external" -> OK GR4 b). a) the external file connector: one run-unit connector per externalized file name (oo_external_file_shared, pb511_external_as_name). b) ALL the record data is run-unit storage: the character half is one cell keyed FD::<name>; each OUT-OF-LINE record (D-FRA: a dynamic-length record, a variable-length group, a pointer record) is its own cell keyed FD::<name>#<k> by its ordinal among the file's out-of-line records (GR5 externalizes the file name, never a record name), its dynamic-length content riding the cell's dynamic slots (StorageCell.DynAt; Place.DynSlotWindow / VarGroupWindow). The 2014 golden has three separately compiled programs describing the file under different record names: each sees the others' dynamic-length, variable-length-group and pointer record values, and a READ in one program lands in all of them (D-FRA take step). Staged loud (COBOL0899) before PB1026.
